description: Work out a mixed vial's strength, the units to read on a U-100 insulin syringe for a given amount, and how many doses the vial holds, from the vial's mg, the water's mL and the amount. Arithmetic on the numbers given, the same math as PepVault's calculator, not a dose recommendation.

compound.description: The compound in the vial, to link its vial chart.

dose.description: The amount to draw, in dose_unit.

syringe_ml.description: The U-100 insulin syringe's size in mL (0.3, 0.5 or 1), to check the amount fits.

vial_mg.description: The vial's amount of powder, in mg.

name: reconstitution
title: Reconstitution arithmetic
